goal.title: Full Stack Development
goal.tagline: Master modern frontend, scalable backend architectures, and production deployment
goal.description: From JavaScript basics to architecting full-scale web applications, cloud hosting, and cracking software engineering technical interviews.

careerPath.title: Beginner Foundations
careerPath.subtitle: Web Fundamentals & Programming Mindset
careerPath.description: Build core literacy in HTML semantic structure, CSS modern layout models (Flexbox/Grid), and JavaScript core execution context.
milestones: Understand DOM manipulation and event loop

careerPath.title: Interactive Frontend Mastery
careerPath.subtitle: React Ecosystem & State Management
careerPath.description: Build reactive user interfaces, custom hooks, component hierarchies, and clean client-side routing.
milestones: Create multi-page React SPA with Vite

careerPath.title: Robust Backend & Persistence
careerPath.subtitle: Node.js, Express & MongoDB Database
careerPath.description: Design RESTful APIs, relational/document schemas, JWT authorization, and middleware pipelines.
milestones: Build CRUD API with Express & Mongoose

careerPath.title: Full-Stack Portfolio Projects
careerPath.subtitle: Production Applications & System Architecture
careerPath.description: Assemble end-to-end full stack applications with real-time features, secure payments or notifications.
milestones: Maintain clean Git commit history on GitHub

careerPath.title: Technical Interview Preparation
careerPath.subtitle: Data Structures, System Design & Behavioral
careerPath.description: Solve 100+ LeetCode problems (Arrays, Hashmaps, Trees), practice system design fundamentals, and mock interviews.
milestones: Target Career: SDE-1 at tech companies

mentors.name: Priya Sharma
mentors.headline: Senior SDE at Microsoft | Ex-Amazon | Tech Interview Mentor
mentors.expertField: Full Stack Architecture, Distributed Systems & MERN
mentors.bio: Over 6 years of experience scaling distributed systems and mentoring 120+ students into top tier tech companies. Specializes in MERN architecture, backend scalability, and behavioral interview coaching.
whatTheyShare: High-throughput distributed systems & backend architecture review
Realistic FAANG coding & behavioral mock interview drills

mentors.name: Devika Patel
mentors.headline: Staff Infrastructure Engineer at Cloudflare | Ex-Meta
mentors.expertField: Cloud Native DevOps, Kubernetes & High Availability
mentors.bio: Specialist in cloud native deployment, containerization, distributed databases, and high availability systems across multi-region networks.
whatTheyShare: Multi-region Kubernetes cluster deployment & zero-downtime routing
Database sharding, caching strategies with Redis & CDN internals
Hands-on Terraform & CI/CD pipeline architectural audits

stages.title: Stage 1: HTML & Modern CSS Layouts
stages.shortSummary: Semantic structure, CSS Flexbox, CSS Grid, and responsive design principles.

topics.title: HTML5 Semantic Architecture
topics.description: Semantic tags, accessibility (a11y), forms, and SEO document hierarchy.
practiceTasks: Build accessible survey form
Create multi-section landing page

topics.title: Modern CSS Layouts & Responsive Design
topics.description: Flexbox, Grid systems, CSS variables, media queries, and mobile-first workflow.
practiceTasks: Clone pricing page with Grid
Build responsive navbar with mobile toggle

stages.milestoneOutcome: Able to turn any Figma design into a responsive web page.

stages.title: Stage 2: JavaScript Mastery (ES6+)
stages.shortSummary: Execution context, closures, asynchronous JS, DOM manipulation, and modern syntax.

topics.title: JS Engine Fundamentals & Scope
topics.description: Call stack, execution context, hoisting, closures, and lexical environment.
practiceTasks: Implement custom debounce and throttle functions
Build closure-based cache

topics.title: Asynchronous JavaScript & Fetch API
topics.description: Promises, async/await, error handling, and fetching data from third-party APIs.
practiceTasks: Build weather application consuming public API
Implement search autocomplete

stages.milestoneOutcome: Comfortable with vanilla JavaScript, modern ES6+ features, and async operations.

stages.title: Stage 3: React.js & Single Page Applications
stages.shortSummary: Components, JSX, Hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef), and React Router.

topics.title: React Components, Props & State
topics.description: Declarative UI, component lifecycle, JSX compilation, and unidirectional data flow.
practiceTasks: Build interactive task tracker with filters
Create modal component library

topics.title: Advanced Hooks, Effects & React Router
topics.description: Side effects with useEffect, dependency arrays, custom hooks, and dynamic client routing.
practiceTasks: Build multi-page storefront with routing
Create custom useLocalStorage hook

stages.milestoneOutcome: Able to architect modern, reactive web frontends with clean component separation.

stages.title: Stage 4: Node.js Core & Express REST APIs
stages.shortSummary: V8 engine, Event Loop, Express routing, middleware chains, controller architecture, and validation.

topics.title: Node.js Architecture & Event-Driven I/O
topics.description: Non-blocking I/O, libuv thread pool, events emitter, and module formats (ESM vs CJS).
practiceTasks: Build CLI file manager in Node.js
Create custom EventEmitter logger

topics.title: Express Routing & Middleware Architecture
topics.description: Application middleware, router middleware, third-party middleware (cors, morgan), and controllers.
practiceTasks: Create modular CRUD API with Express router
Implement global error handler and logger

stages.milestoneOutcome: Capable of writing clean, production-grade REST APIs in Express.js.

stages.title: Stage 5: MongoDB & Mongoose Persistence
stages.shortSummary: NoSQL document design, schemas, indexes, relationships, and aggregation pipelines.

topics.title: MongoDB Schema Design & Validation
topics.description: Mongoose models, schemas, data types, validators, pre/post middleware hooks.
practiceTasks: Design User, Post, and Comment schemas with referential integrity

topics.title: Mongoose Queries & Aggregations
topics.description: Populate, complex filters, update operators, and aggregation pipelines ($match, $group, $sort).
practiceTasks: Write aggregation pipeline calculating monthly statistics by category

stages.milestoneOutcome: Confidently model real-world business data with high query efficiency.

stages.title: Stage 6: Authentication, Security & Deployment
stages.shortSummary: JWT authorization, bcrypt, role-based access, Vercel/Render cloud deployment, and CI/CD.

topics.title: Secure Authentication & JWT Tokens
topics.description: Token payload, signature verification, token expiration, and secure HTTP cookies vs bearer headers.
practiceTasks: Implement signup, login, and verifyToken workflow

topics.title: Production Deployment & Full-Stack Integration
topics.description: Connecting React with Express backend, Vercel deployment, Render cloud backend, and environment secrets.
practiceTasks: Deploy live full-stack app with production MongoDB Atlas cluster

stages.milestoneOutcome: Full-stack application deployed live on the internet with authenticated workflows.
